say: Deep inside, they are slowly falling apart.
In eighteen ninety-six, Henri Becquerel left uranium salts on a wrapped photographic plate.
In the dark, the plate fogged anyway.

say: Marie Curie named this energy radioactivity.
With Pierre Curie, she discovered two new elements: polonium and radium.

say: Each kind of atom has a half-life:
the time it takes for half of its atoms to change.
Carbon fourteen has a half-life of about five thousand, seven hundred years,
so it can date ancient wood and bone.

Her notebooks are still radioactive today.
